description: A full-stack web application for students and faculty to share achievements, upload documents, and interact through a social platform
key_features: User registration and authentication with role-based access
Blog post creation and management with approval workflow
PDF file upload and sharing functionality
Admin dashboard for user and content management

user_roles.Student: Can create posts, upload PDFs, like/dislike content
user_roles.Faculty: Same as students with additional privileges
user_roles.Admin: Full access to manage users, approve/reject content

technical_highlights: Responsive React components with Tailwind CSS
RESTful API design with proper error handling
